## Merge checklist

- [ ] The change is acceptance-specific and independently authorized.
- [ ] Assertions are new, equivalent, or stronger.
- [ ] No production source or private implementation detail is imported.
- [ ] Complete diff and generated evidence were reviewed.
- [ ] Required checks pass for the current head SHA.
- [ ] All review conversations are resolved.
- [ ] The human owner will squash merge; the authoring agent will not merge.
